notes.title: 🏂 Get a new point of view with the free update 🏂
notes.content:
Hello Mountain Lovers,

A [b]new update[/b] for [i]Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands[/i] is now available [b]for free[/b]! You can now [b]change your point of view[/b] between Front and Behind Cameras with just the press of a button, so that you can enjoy the mountains ⛰️ like never before!

https://youtu.be/teRQ0DCL4gY

📬 [b]Stay connected![/b]

notes.title: Steam Fest Livestream and demo update
notes.content:
Hello riders, 

Interested in seeing [b]the team behind Grand Mountain Adventures: Wonderland play[/b] their game? Meet us today at 6h45pm CET/9H45am PST for a livestream showcasing our winterly adventure. [b]We would love to answer all of your questions![/b]

Some of you might have already noticed a small patch for the demo, [b]we know some players encountered a black-screen issue[/b] we are trying to fix it, hopefully before this stream ːwinter2019happydogː

And another new update: GMA: Wonderlands now [b]supports 4 instead of 2 controllers connected [/b]at the same time. Which is awesome when playing remotely with friends

stay safe and see you on the ski tracks ːwinter2019joyfultearssnowmanː
